user_story:
As a user, I want to browse products on the mobile viewport using the burger menu, so that I can easily access different product categories and add items to my cart.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The user can open the burger menu by clicking the button with the selector '[data-test="open-menu"]'.
2. The user can see a list of product categories including 'All Items' (selector: '[data-test="inventory-sidebar-link"]') and 'About' (selector: '[data-test="about-sidebar-link"]').
3. The user can close the burger menu by clicking the button with the selector '[data-test="close-menu"]'.
4. The user can add products to the cart by clicking the buttons with selectors such as '[data-test="add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack"]', '[data-test="add-to-cart-sauce-labs-bike-light"]', etc.
5. The user can only add products that are visible on the current page, and if no product is added, the cart icon remains unchanged.
